Added encoders and decoders for the generic fact events of telemetry 1.8 (FACT, FACT_INTERNAL, FACT_SERIES, FACT_SERIES_INTERNAL).
Added the declaration of one KIND of observable fact: "the hero took a step", "a spell was cast", "a status effect began", "gold was spent".
